title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 27 — Statutory provision (ACA s. 27)

content.overview: Section 27 permits the arbitral tribunal, or a party with tribunal approval, to apply to the Court for assistance in taking evidence. The statutory procedure governs the application and execution of the evidentiary process.
content.glance: Section 27 permits the arbitral tribunal, or a party with tribunal approval, to apply to the Court for assistance in taking evidence. The statutory procedure governs the application and execution of the evidentiary process.
content.study:
Section 27 — Court assistance in taking evidence

Section 27 permits the arbitral tribunal, or a party with tribunal approval, to apply to the Court for assistance in taking evidence. The statutory procedure governs the application and execution of the evidentiary process.

Apply the provision by identifying operative conditions, exceptions, procedural stage and connected provisions. Do not substitute generic arbitration practice for the statutory rule.
